Dear Sirs/Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio recording of earnings conference call to discuss financial results for the  
second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 and with further reference to our letter bearing sc no. 129 dated October 5, 2026, 
we wish to inform you that the audio call recording of earnings conference call on the Financial 
Results and operations of Tata Motors Limited (formerly TML Commercial Vehicles Limited) for 
the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, has been made available on the 
Company's website. 
 
The link to access the said audio recording is: Tata Motors Q2 FY27 earnings call recording 
 
This is for information of the Exchanges and the Members. 
 
 
Yours faithfully 
Tata Motors Limited 
(formerly TML Commercial Vehicles Limited)  
 
 
 
 
Ranjan Kumar 
General Counsel & Company Secretary 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  
RANJAN 
KUMAR
